description: dagger/go.mod and go.sum are written by `dagger develop`, not by hand.
The engine generates dagger/internal/dagger at run time and it is not checked in,
so renovate's `go get -t ./...` cannot resolve the module and never updates
go.sum: every pull request here arrives with a stale sum and an
Worse, the versions are not ours to choose. `dagger develop` rewrites the
replace directives to whatever the engine pinned in dagger.json wants, so a
merged bump is undone by the next run. Measured on pull request #21, which
dagger develop reverted to main exactly.
The way to move these is to raise the module version in dagger.json.
